name: Kajuu 100%
source: It's about a guy who gets cursed, and to break the curse, he has to go on an erotic vacation with some sexy ladies he met at a tropical resort. The curse requires him to collect some "naughty juices" to break it. The ladies are already pretty frisky, and they're all enjoying the tropical vibes. The question is, will he be able to break the curse, or will he "melt" from all the steamy action?
